_comment: Elenco fijo de los cómics de perros. 'voice_prompt' es la descripción con la que el robot INVENTA la voz en ElevenLabs (Voice Design); córrelo con robot-disenar-voces.mjs y se llena 'voice_id' solo. 'visual' mantiene al personaje IDÉNTICO en cada imagen/video. 'voice_settings' afina el carácter de la voz al hablar (stability bajo = más expresivo/variable, style alto = más actuado).
estilo_global: Photorealistic, cinematic lighting, realistic fur detail, shallow depth of field, warm indoor lighting

Kaiser.personalidad: El líder. Serio, da órdenes, impone respeto.
Kaiser.voice_prompt: A mature adult male voice, deep, steady and commanding. Calm and authoritative like a disciplined squad leader who is used to being obeyed. Measured, controlled pacing, never shouting.
Kaiser.visual: a confident adult German Shepherd with classic black-and-tan coat, alert upright ears, standing tall and composed like a leader

Africa.personalidad: La protectora. Fuerte sin medir su fuerza, lista pero obedece solo cuando quiere, no deja a nadie atras. Noble pero un poco abusiva.
Africa.voice_prompt: A deep, powerful, calm female voice with quiet authority and a slight rasp, like a strong protective figure who does not need to raise her voice to be obeyed.
Africa.visual: a large powerful female black Giant Schnauzer with a thick black coat, bushy eyebrows and beard, muscular and imposing but with calm intelligent eyes

Rex.personalidad: Dramatico, cree que es un lobo, exagera todo.
Rex.voice_prompt: A theatrical, over-the-top adult male voice, dramatic and intensely emotional, prone to wailing and exaggeration, like a melodramatic stage actor who treats every small event as a life-or-death tragedy.
Rex.visual: a fluffy Siberian Husky with grey-and-white coat and striking blue eyes, dramatic expressive face, often mid-howl

Bruno.personalidad: Bueno y feliz, sin sentido comun, ama a todos.
Bruno.voice_prompt: A bright, cheerful, goofy young adult male voice, extremely friendly and enthusiastic, a little dopey and innocent, warm and bouncy, like a lovable golden-hearted simpleton who adores everyone.
Bruno.visual: a happy golden retriever with a glossy golden coat, big friendly smile, tongue out, tail clearly wagging

Pixel.personalidad: El cerebro. Se aburre y trama planes.
Pixel.voice_prompt: A quick, clever, slightly smug adult male voice, sharp, crisp and articulate, like a witty mastermind who is always three steps ahead and a touch sarcastic.
Pixel.visual: an alert black-and-white Border Collie with intense focused eyes and a sharp clever expression

Tank.personalidad: Mini, ego gigante, siempre busca pelea.
Tank.voice_prompt: An adult male voice with a naturally high, nasal, reedy tone, fast and energetic and full of comic over-the-top confidence, like a small dog with a huge personality who is absolutely sure he runs the place.
Tank.visual: a tiny brown-and-white short-haired Chihuahua, comically small but with a furious aggressive expression and huge attitude

SirWheeze.personalidad: Perezoso, ronca, solo quiere el sofa.
SirWheeze.voice_prompt: A slow, deep, sleepy adult male voice with a posh British accent, gravelly and unbothered, mumbling and droopy like an aristocrat who just woke up from a nap and only wants to go back to sleep.
SirWheeze.visual: a chubby wrinkly English Bulldog with a stocky body and droopy jowls, looking sleepy and unbothered, usually lying down
